purpose: Teach: 一撃/行財政/主審/官民/裏づけ/等価/定型/総勢

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織に一撃を与える捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police conduct decisive investigations against criminal organizations, don't they.
lines.style: Conversational, slightly formal. Steady cadence, as if moving through a checklist. Warm but observational—noting facts with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、行財政の不正にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle cases involving administrative and financial misconduct, don't they.
lines.style: Same measured tempo. Light emphasis on 「also」—connecting this to a larger pattern. No rush, no judgment. Just... noting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、競技会の主審の安全確保もされますね
lines.en: The police ensure the safety of referees and officials at sporting events too, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the same gentle cataloging. A small smile in the voice—the recognition of something careful and attentive in the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、官民連携の防犯活動を進められますね
lines.en: The police advance public-private partnership crime prevention activities, don't they.
lines.style: Still steady, still warm. The word 「partnership」 lands with quiet appreciation—the collaborative nature of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、供述の裏づけ捜査を徹底されますね
lines.en: The police conduct thorough corroborating investigations into statements, don't they.
lines.style: No change in pace, but there's a firmness now—the rigor of the work. Still respectful. Slightly slower on 「thorough」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、賠償額を等価な基準で算定されますね
lines.en: The police calculate compensation amounts using consistent standards, don't they.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. The formality settling in deeper. Still conversational, but the tone is becoming more formally professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、定型業務のデジタル化も進められますね
lines.en: The police are advancing the digitization of routine administrative tasks as well, aren't they.
lines.style: Tempo slightly quicker now—we're building. The energy lifting just a fraction. Still warm, but with forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、総勢百名の捜査本部を立ち上げられますね
lines.en: The police can establish full-scale investigative task forces of a hundred personnel, can't they.
lines.style: Shift now—firmer, more direct. The opening word lands with weight. Slightly faster. The scale of the operation comes through in the voice.
